title: units-verification
summary: Checks every row of memory/semantic/units.md (58 symbols from Kaempfer & Plapp 2009 and Moure & Fu 2024 with its SI) against images of the cited pages: unit, printed symbol, meaning, page and printed value. Marker (a local OCR model) and a Sonnet agent each read the pages independently, the agent without seeing the table's answer; a script compares both readings with the table; an Opus agent judges the rows that disagree and reviews every row's meaning. Agents run headless in a clean folder holding only page images, and a script audits each transcript.

The pipeline is first run on ten rows with planted errors and four untouched controls, and the real run starts only if it catches them. The user inspects every row the Opus agent flagged plus a random 10 % of the agreed rows. Page images and Marker text are not committed; they are reproducible from the DOIs and PDF hashes in the manifest.
status: Stages 1 and 2 built; agents awaiting approval; real run, U1 and S5 not yet. 2026-10-22. Details: WORKFLOW.md.

nodes.title: U0 Supply sources
nodes.job: Supplies any missing source PDF and confirms which file is each source.
details: All three sources present since 2026-10-22 (from Zotero)

nodes.title: S0 locate_sources.py
nodes.job: Finds each source PDF by the DOI on its first page and records its path and hash.
details: Files whose rendered pages are identical count as one source
Missing or ambiguous source: stop and ask the user (U0)

nodes.title: manifest.json
nodes.job: Run record: sources, hashes of PDFs, pages and agent files, git commit, tool versions, model IDs.

nodes.title: S1 render_pages.py
nodes.job: Renders each cited page and its two neighbours to PNG at 200 dpi with mutool.
details: Images only; the text layer is never used

nodes.title: pages/<source>_p<N>.png
nodes.job: One image per page, with its SHA-256 in the manifest; not committed, re-rendered from the DOIs and hashes.

nodes.title: S1b marker_extract.py
nodes.job: Converts every page to Markdown with LaTeX math using Marker, a local OCR model.
details: Forced OCR, no LLM; independent of the Sonnet reader
Also indexes which page defines each symbol

nodes.title: marker/<source>_p<N>.md
nodes.job: Marker's reading of each page and the symbol-to-page index; page text is not committed.

nodes.title: C0 calibrate.py (runs once, first)
nodes.job: Runs S2 to S4m on ten rows with planted errors and four untouched controls and checks they are caught.
details: Planted: 8 unit or page errors (flipped exponent sign, wrong prefix, swapped unit, wrong page) and 2 swapped meanings
Pass: S3 flags 8/8, S4 rejects at least 7/8, S4m catches 2/2
False alarms on the 4 controls are reported

nodes.title: calibration.json
nodes.job: Planted errors and whether each stage caught them.

nodes.title: S2 morty-unit-reader
nodes.job: Reads one page image and transcribes how each requested symbol is defined there.
details: Given only the symbol names, never the table's units or values
Returns printed form, meaning, value, unit and location, or not found
Fresh context per page
Runs headless in a clean folder with only the page image; transcript audited for the pinned model and Read-only use

nodes.title: reads/<page>.json, runs.db
nodes.job: The blind readings, and one database row per agent call.

nodes.title: S3 compare_units.py
nodes.job: Compares the table's unit and printed symbol with the blind reading and with Marker's, by dimension and scale.
details: J/(m^3 K) equals J m^-3 K^-1; a degC difference equals K
Printed symbols compared without sub/superscript marks: ρi equals ρ_i; ρv differs from ρ_vs
AGREE only if the table, the blind read and Marker all agree; otherwise DISAGREE or NOT_FOUND

nodes.title: S4 beth-unit-checker
nodes.job: Decides each DISAGREE or NOT_FOUND row from the page image and states where on the page the answer is.
details: Gets the page image, the table row, the blind reading and Marker's
Verdict: table right, reading right, both wrong (with fix) or cannot tell
Fresh context per row; a fix must pass S3 again; cannot tell goes to the user
Same headless clean-folder run and transcript audit as S2

nodes.title: verdicts.json
nodes.job: One verdict per S4 or S4m row, with its location on the page.

nodes.title: S4m beth-unit-checker (meaning review)
nodes.job: Reviews whether each row's meaning matches the quantity the cited page defines for its symbol.
details: Pass 1, per page: page image, and per row the table's symbol and meaning and the blind read's meaning
Pass 2, per row pass 1 could not settle: cited page plus up to 3 pages where Marker finds the symbol, earliest first, including the main paper for SI rows
Verdict: matches, table wrong (page's wording and page) or cannot tell, with location
Anything but matches after pass 2: row is disputed and goes to U1

nodes.title: U1 Inspect
nodes.job: Approve or correct every row from S4 or S4m, and a random 10 % of the agreed rows (rounded up).
details: Each shown with its page crop beside the table row and the reading

nodes.title: S5 apply_verdicts.py
nodes.job: Writes each row's final status into units.md and closes the run record.
details: The UNRELIABLE header is removed only when no row is unresolved

nodes.title: memory/semantic/units.md
nodes.job: The verified table, committed with the run manifest.
